**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The document already delivers the substance of the TRANSITION rule, and it runs in our favour as PB:

- **Section 14.3** (p0782–p0789) — on any termination (absent a Program Transfer), SFJ must assign the Trial Data Package/Research Results to PB, assign and deliver complete copies of all Product Filings, disclose previously-undisclosed Research Results, and — at PB's sole election — either wind down the Clinical Trials at SFJ's cost or transfer control and *keep running them for a transition period* so the handover is uninterrupted, plus assign all CRO/Site/Vendor Agreements with good-faith cooperation.
- **Section 11.1.1.4** (p0663) — ownership of the Trial Data Package transfers to PB on termination.
- **Section 3.11.1** (p0335) — PB can require transfer of all Clinical Trial data, CRFs and the Clinical Trials Master File (or destruction at our option).
- **Section 10.3** (p0640) — return or destruction of Confidential Information at the disclosing party's direction, **with written officer certification of destruction** — the certified-deletion element of our preferred position.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged: the delivery period in 14.3.3 and the trial-continuation period in 14.3.4 are redacted ([***]) rather than stated as 30 days / 6 months, and no machine-readable format standard is specified. Worth confirming the redacted periods are at least 30 days and 90 days respectively, but these are sub-elements short of preferred wording, not fallback failures.
